overall: Atlanta has had a modest heating day with temperatures peaking at 80.6°F around 15:00 ET and holding flat through 17:00, then beginning to cool. The day ran noticeably cooler than model guidance anticipated, likely due to clouds, moisture, or weaker mixing than expected.
forecast_obs_notes: All three models (ECMWF 83.1°F, HRRR 82.5°F, NBM 82.3°F) clustered tightly in the 82–83°F range, showing strong inter-model agreement, but the observed running max of 80.6°F fell roughly 2–2.5°F short of consensus. max_temp_prediction: With the running max locked in at 80.6°F since 15:00 ET, temperatures now falling at nearly 2°F/hr, and no plausible mechanism to reheat past the afternoon peak at 19:34 ET, the daily high is almost certainly already set. Confidence is very high that 80.6°F is the final TMAX for today — the models were too warm by approximately 2°F, and the observed trend leaves essentially no path to a late-evening rebound.
